hits.title: AArete Names Healthcare Executive Pam Shipley as Chief Executive Officer
hits.snippet: _Global consulting firm's founder Loren Trimble to step down after 18 years of growth and leadership_ **CHICAGO, August 12, 2026** --( [BUSINESS WIRE](https://www.businesswire.com) )-- [AArete](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.aarete.com%2F&esheet=54587379&newsitemid=20260810294659&lan=en-US&anchor=AArete&index=1&md5=2a5e7c9c62ae078b77191d5b13524728) , a leading global management and technology consulting firm, announced today the appointment of Pam Shipley as chief executive officer. A Fortune 25 healthcare executive with more than 30 years of experience, Shipley succeeds AArete founder Loren Trimble, who will transition from his role as CEO to board member. Shipley joins AArete from Centene Corporation, a leading managed care organization, in which she most recently served as chief strategy officer. She spent nearly 14 years at Centene over two tenures where she held multiple CEO roles in Georgia, Missouri and Mississippi and led digital transformation and market expansion across more than 15 markets.
